Global leaders in precision metrology, additive manufacturing and position measurement

Delivering intelligent measurement and manufacturing solutions that power world‑class efficiency and scientific discovery. Our technologies help customers solve complex challenges and achieve reliable results in high-precision environments.

Over 50 years of innovation

Founded in 1973 by Sir David McMurtry and John Deer, Renishaw has spent over 50 years engineering change. The touch-trigger probe — invented by Sir David while working on Concorde engines — revolutionised precision engineering and set the direction for decades of innovation.
